text:
sam: Heads up — onboarding results for sift-embed-v1 are in. Seeing a noticeable recall@10 drop vs our baseline on the wiki holdout. Can someone glance?

jiayi: quick summary from the smoke run:
```
baseline (bert-embed v3) | cosine recall@10 = 0.783
sift-embed-v1 (no-norm)   | l2 recall@10     = 0.712
sift-embed-v1 (cosine)    | cosine recall@10 = 0.761
sift-embed-v1 int8        | cosine recall@10 = 0.742
```
(holdout size 50k, k=10)

oliver: did you apply l2-normalization during extract? L2 distance is scale-sensitive — looks like baseline pipeline does a per-vector norm step. :thinking_face:

sam: Good call — our pipeline for sift forgot the final normalize. We left raw outputs (float32) and evaluated both L2 and cosine out of habit.

priya: that would explain big gap between l2 and cosine for sift. Also note cluster metrics: silhouette dropped. Numbers from the same run:
```
silhouette_baseline = 0.421
silhouette_sift_no_norm = 0.312
```

leo: Also saw negative-pair calibration issues — precision@1 on hard-negatives fell: 0.68 -> 0.59. Could be embedding geometry (length variance) or quantization artifacts when we go int8.

eval-bot: embedding-eval: Attachments uploaded: /artifacts/1769992220/sift-smoke-report.json (perf + recall tables).

jiayi: Proposed quick experiments:
- rerun with per-vector L2-normalize before indexing
- run cosine vs l2 explicitly and keep distance consistent between index and query
- ablate int8 quantization (per-channel vs per-tensor)
- re-evaluate with hard-negative mining on same holdout

sam: I'm going to run the normalized rerun (50k holdout) now. Command for reproducibility:
```bash
python eval/recall.py --model sift-embed-v1 --distance cosine --normalize True --holdout 50000 --hard-negatives 2 --output /tmp/sift-rerun.json
```

oliver: Also try whitening step we use for some customers: `apply_whitening(embed, pca_mu, pca_components)` — occasionally reduces centroid drift.

priya: If normalization fixes most gap, we should add pipeline assertion: index and query must both be normalized when model config says "use_cosine:true". File a tiny infra change so future bring-ups catch this.

leo: For quantization: if per-channel int8 recovers >0.75 cosine recall@10 we can proceed, otherwise consider int6 trial but watch calibration.

sam: Thanks team — I'll post numbers in this thread in ~20m. cc @jiayi @oliver @priya

jiayi: thx. also adding a small script to compute pairwise length-distribution: `python tools/length_stats.py --model sift-embed-v1` — helps spot scale variance early.

sam: quick update (20m): normalized rerun results -> cosine recall@10 = 0.775, silhouette = 0.408, precision@1 hard-neg = 0.69. int8 per-channel rerun in progress.

priya: great, normalization moved us close to baseline. proceed with int8 per-channel run and report delta. :thumbsup:

oliver: filing follow-up ticket for pipeline assertion + add small unittest on normalization consistency.

sam: logging here: ticket INF-2482 created for norm assert + eval hook. Will attach final int8 numbers when ready.

eval-bot: scheduled job: int8 per-channel quant eval queued (job id 1769992220-qt).

leo: nice — if int8 drops >0.03 we'll experiment with calibration scaling (post-quant scale factor).

sam: closing for now, will reopen if int8 looks bad. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
